name: Those Nights at Fredbear's: New Destiny
summary: Those Nights at Fredbear's: New Destiny is a reimagination of the cancelled original game Those Nights at Fredbear's by Nikson. Survive through all your nightshifts while avoiding the main animatronic cast: Spring Bonnie, Spring Freddy, Plushtrap and the main star, Fredbear.
